Name: Call
Description: Phone or voice call. Outcome (Connected, LeftVoicemail, NoAnswer) lives on the Activity.

Name: Email
Description: Email message. Direction (Inbound/Outbound) lives on the Activity.

Name: Meeting
Description: In-person or virtual meeting. Organizer/Attendee roles live on ActivityLink.

Name: Note
Description: Free-form note logged against one or more records.

Name: System Event
Description: A lifecycle or system-generated timeline entry.

Name: Chat
Description: Instant message or chat transcript excerpt.
